summary: Replace the heuristic layout with multi-start SLSQP that optimises centres and radii jointly, maximising the sum of radii under analytic-Jacobian pair and wall constraints. Later starts are perturbations of the best solution found, and a final shrink pass guarantees feasibility.

Replace the "always perturb the best" search with basin hopping. It perturbs a current state that may accept slightly worse results, resets to the best after stagnation, and mixes in occasional random restarts. The time budget also goes up to 250 s.

After the search, I add a final linear-programming polish that finds the exact optimal radii for the best centres, with a tiny safety margin. It keeps the result only if it is feasible and has a larger sum than the best found.
